method: Zero-epsilon recentered BVH candidate search, followed by EXACT integer/rational triangle-plane and coplanar polygon predicates on exported float32 coordinates scaled by2^149. Shared-edge contacts are allowed only within that exact edge; positive segments extending beyond a shared vertex and positive coplanar area are flagged. No tolerance threshold used to discard an actual positive intersection. BVH candidate completeness and full static-source self-intersection are not universally certified.
scope: Queried local contact pairs only. BVH completeness and all inherited source self-intersections not certified. No full-mouth readability, anatomy or runtime pass.
